notes: Particle burst wrapper. Wraps any child (Button, Link, Card, raw element) and fires a particle burst on click or hover. Particle visual is a Shape config — rendered to a hidden <template> at build time, cloned per particle at runtime. Two engines: fly (Web Animations, fade-out) and physics (gravity + AABB collision against page text + optional cursor magnet). Modules import globally via BaseLayout. In textonly the wrapper still renders so children survive — runtime gates auto-init via render-mode check.

_rules.note: palette='tiers' cycles through 4 tiers of brandColor. Without brandColor there's nothing to cycle.
palette='rainbow' ignores brandColor/rainbowColor; palette='tiers' uses brandColor but ignores colorTier and rainbowColor (cycles instead).
gravity/magnet/collide/mode only meaningful when engine='physics' — runtime ignores them otherwise.
Use one or the other. particleSvg embeds raw markup; particle delegates to Shape or Icon. If both provided, particleSvg wins.

preset._description: Pre-configured prop bundle. Author-supplied props still win — the preset only fills keys you left undefined.

preset.description: starfall: rainbow star icons cascading from a click point, passing through most text and pooling on the viewport floor. vortex: rainbow sparkles fly inward from viewport edges to the cursor, then magnet-orbit the cursor as it moves — stellar-parallax depth (big = fast/bright, small = slow/faded).

particle._description: Particle visual — Shape or Icon config. Build-time rendered into a hidden template; cloned per particle at runtime. Shape covers primitives, D1 logos via slug, custom SVG. Icon renders Phosphor glyphs directly. When palette is set, the particle renders multiple times — once per palette colour.

particleSvg._description: Three input shapes accepted: (1) raw SVG markup '<svg>...</svg>', (2) 'logo:KEY' shorthand resolved from BRAND_CONFIG.logo (KEY ∈ primary | monochrome | favicon | wordmark), (3) public/-relative path. Read at build time, embedded verbatim. Paths get fill='currentColor' injected so colour/palette props apply via the .color--{name} mixin.

particleSize._description: Particle size in px — used for particleSvg only. Shape/Icon size tokens come from their own props.

colour._description: Single brand colour for every particle. Mutually exclusive with palette.

brandColor.description: Brand-scale colour applied uniformly to every particle.

colorTier.description: Tier modifier for brandColor. Ignored when palette='tiers' (which cycles all four).

rainbow._description: Single rainbow colour for every particle. Mutually exclusive with palette.

palette._description: Multi-particle colour cycle — runtime picks a different palette colour per particle.

palette.description: tiers: cycles particles through tint/mid/base/emphasis of brandColor (4 colours). rainbow: cycles particles through rainbow-1..rainbow-7 (7 colours).

engine.description: fly: outward burst, fade out (Web Animations). physics: gravity, AABB collision against page text/buttons, optional cursor magnet. string: silly-string Verlet rope — connected points sprayed from origin, gravity, AABB collision, render as SVG path.

from.description: Where each particle/strand spawns. origin (default) = burst element centre. top/bottom/left/right = random along that viewport edge. edges = random pick from all four. viewport = random anywhere on screen.

to.description: Where particles head. away (default) = radial outward. origin = converge on burst element centre (reverse confetti). cursor = aim at cursor position at fire time. target = converge on the element matched by 'target' selector (hero reveal pattern).

target.description: CSS selector used when to='target'. The element's centre becomes the destination, and data-string-landed is set on first contact (CSS hooks for reveal effects).

mode.description: [physics only] Force preset. fall: upward emit + gravity (default). explode: full-radial outward, low gravity, no collide. float: rise + sinusoidal drift, no collide. orbit: tangential force around cursor, no collide. shake: like fall but bounces twice on collision before settling.

trigger.description: click: fire on click (links delay nav 400ms). hover: fire once on mouseenter, retrigger after 2s. hover-hold: fire continuously every 1.5s while hovered, stops on mouseleave (use for ambient decoration on important UI).

spread.description: Spread radius in px (fly) or horizontal scatter (physics).

lifespan.description: Particle lifetime in ms before fade-out. Floored at 1000 by string engine so a tiny lifespan still gets a visible fade.

physics._description: Physics engine knobs — engine='physics' only, ignored otherwise

gravity.description: Vertical acceleration in px/frame². Higher = particles fall faster. Also used by engine='string'.

magnet.description: Particles attract toward cursor while alive.

collide.description: Particles stop on contact with p/h1/h2/h3/button/a rects (text 'lands' on words). Set false to fall to viewport floor only. Also used by engine='string'.

stickiness.description: 0–1 probability a falling particle/strand-point sticks on a top-edge contact. 0.5 = half pass through to the next rect below (distributes across rows). 1.0 = always stick on first contact. Lower = more particles fall further. Particles are gated to falling motion only — upward burst phase ignores collision.

string._description: Verlet-rope engine knobs — engine='string' only, ignored otherwise. Particle visual props (particle/particleSvg) are unused for this engine; palette/brandColor/rainbowColor still drive strand colour.

strands.description: Strands emitted per click. Each strand picks a random colour from the palette.

length.description: Points per strand. More = longer rope.

pressure.description: Initial point speed (px/frame). Higher = strand sprays farther before gravity catches it.

emitDuration.description: ms over which the strand grows. Shorter = whip-crack, longer = lazy spray.

thick.description: Stroke width of the rendered strand path in px.

tracePath.description: SVG path data, or 'logo:KEY' shorthand. After the strand flies in, each point lerps to a sampled position along this path — strand 'writes' or 'draws' the shape. Multi-path logos render as N strand-shapes (one strand per path) preserving original layout. Coordinates auto-centred + scaled to traceSize. Mutually exclusive with magnetCursor.

traceSize.description: Target width in px — traced path is auto-centred and scaled so its bounding box matches this size.

traceWiggle.description: Wiggle preset for snapped trace points. Points orbit a small radius around their target with per-point phase offsets so the rope retains silly-string motion through the finished outline. off=0 (clean snap), subtle=1.5px (default, barely visible), soft=3px (gentle sway), heavy=6px (pronounced flail). Pure aesthetic knob — letter readability stays intact through 'soft'.

magnetCursor.description: Cursor magnet mode. true / 'attract' = swarm follows cursor. 'repel' = cursor pushes points away (parts the rope as you wade through). false / 'off' = no cursor force. Mutually exclusive with tracePath — magnet wins if both set.

inheritAnchorColour.description: When tethered (magnetCursor=attract + collide=true), each strand reads its colour from the anchor element's computed text colour instead of the palette. Tendrils blend into whatever element they hang from.
